# Layer 5: Development Guide

## Prerequisites

| Tool | Version | Required For |
|------|---------|-------------|
| [.NET SDK](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/10.0) | 10.0.200+ | Backend build and run |
| [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) | 20+ | Frontend build (npm) |
| [Docker](https://docs.docker.com/get-docker/) | Latest | PostgreSQL + bitcoind containers |

## Quick Start

```bash
# 1. Start infrastructure
docker-compose up -d

# 2. Restore tools (EF Core CLI)
dotnet tool restore

# 3. Run API (auto-migrates DB + seeds demo user)
dotnet run --project src/BitcoinPayments.API

# 4. (Optional) Run SPA dev server with hot reload
cd src/BitcoinPayments.UI && npm install && npm run dev
```

| Endpoint | URL |
|----------|-----|
| API (HTTPS) | https://localhost:5001 |
| API (HTTP) | http://localhost:5000 |
| SPA dev server | http://localhost:5173 |
| OpenAPI docs (Scalar) | http://localhost:5000/scalar/v1 |
| Health check | http://localhost:5000/health |

## Build Commands

```bash
# Build entire solution
dotnet build BitcoinPayments.sln

# Build SPA for production (outputs to src/BitcoinPayments.API/wwwroot/)
cd src/BitcoinPayments.UI && npm run build
```

## Test Commands

```bash
# All tests
dotnet test BitcoinPayments.sln

# Unit tests (fast, no Docker)
dotnet test tests/BitcoinPayments.UnitTests

# Integration tests (spins up Testcontainers PostgreSQL)
dotnet test tests/BitcoinPayments.IntegrationTests

# E2E tests (requires docker-compose services running)
dotnet test tests/BitcoinPayments.EndToEndTests

# Single test by name
dotnet test tests/BitcoinPayments.UnitTests --filter "FullyQualifiedName~CoinSelectionServiceTests"
```

| Test Suite | Framework | Infrastructure | Coverage |
|-----------|-----------|---------------|----------|
| **UnitTests** | xUnit + Moq | None | Application services, domain logic, handlers |
| **IntegrationTests** | xUnit + Testcontainers.PostgreSql | Real PostgreSQL | EF Core persistence, Bitcoin operations |
| **EndToEndTests** | xUnit + Mvc.Testing | Docker Compose services | Full HTTP request flows |

## EF Core Migrations

```bash
# Restore EF Core tool
dotnet tool restore

# Add a new migration
dotnet ef migrations add <Name> \
  --project src/BitcoinPayments.Infrastructure \
  --startup-project src/BitcoinPayments.API

# Apply migrations
dotnet ef database update \
  --project src/BitcoinPayments.Infrastructure \
  --startup-project src/BitcoinPayments.API
```

Migrations auto-run on startup in Development mode.

## Docker Compose Services

| Service | Image | Port | Purpose |
|---------|-------|------|---------|
| `postgres` | postgres:16 | 5432 | Application database (btcpayments) |
| `bitcoind-regtest` | kylemanna/bitcoind | 18443 | Local regtest Bitcoin node |

```bash
docker-compose up -d    # Start services
docker-compose down     # Stop services
docker-compose logs -f  # Tail logs
```

## Configuration

### appsettings.json structure

| Section | Key Settings |
|---------|-------------|
| `Jwt` | Secret, Issuer, Audience, AccessTokenExpirationMinutes, RefreshTokenExpirationDays |
| `Bitcoin` | Network (testnet4/regtest), DefaultFeeRateSatPerByte, AuthWindowBlocks, MinConfirmationsForSettlement, MempoolApiBaseUrl, TransferMode |
| `ConnectionStrings` | DefaultConnection (PostgreSQL) |
| `BackgroundServices` | ConfirmationWatcherIntervalSeconds, AuthExpiryCheckIntervalSeconds |

### Environment Differences

| Setting | Development | Production |
|---------|------------|------------|
| Network | testnet4 | testnet4 |
| Fee rate | 1 sat/vbyte | 2 sat/vbyte |
| Auth window | 6 blocks | 144 blocks (~1 day) |
| Settlement confirmations | 1 | 3 |
| Access token lifetime | 60 min | 15 min |
| Refresh token lifetime | 30 days | 7 days |
| Log level | Debug | Information |

## Demo Account

On startup, `DemoSeedService` creates a demo user with pre-configured wallets:

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Email | demo@chainvault.dev |
| Password | Demo123! |
| Wallets | 3 wallets with sample transactions |

The SPA login page has a "Try Demo" button that authenticates with these credentials.

## Testing with Testnet4

### What is Testnet4?

Bitcoin's public test network — real blockchain behavior with worthless test coins (tBTC). Transactions confirm exactly like mainnet but with zero financial risk.

### Step-by-Step Guide

1. **Get test Bitcoin** — Visit a [testnet4 faucet](https://mempool.space/testnet4/faucet)
2. **Create wallets** — POST to `/api/v1/wallets` (buyer + merchant)
3. **Get receiving address** — GET `/api/v1/wallets/{id}/address`
4. **Fund from faucet** — Send tBTC to the buyer's address
5. **Execute payments** — Run charge, authorize, capture, void, refund flows
6. **Verify on explorer** — Each response includes an `explorerUrl` linking to [mempool.space/testnet4](https://mempool.space/testnet4)

### 5-Minute Demo Walkthrough

```bash
# Start everything
docker-compose up -d && dotnet run --project src/BitcoinPayments.API

# Open Scalar UI → http://localhost:5000/scalar/v1
# Login as demo user or create wallets via API
# Execute charge → watch state: mempool → confirming → settled
# Execute refund → reverse the payment
```

## CI/CD Pipeline

GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`):

| Job | Trigger | Description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| Build | push/PR to main | `dotnet restore` + `dotnet build --configuration Release` |
| Unit Tests | after Build | Runs UnitTests with TRX reporter |
| Integration Tests | after Build | Runs IntegrationTests with TRX reporter |
| E2E Tests | after Build | Runs EndToEndTests with TRX reporter |

## API Endpoints

### Accounts

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `POST` | `/api/v1/accounts/register` | Register new user |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/accounts/login` | Authenticate, receive JWT |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/accounts/refresh` | Refresh access token |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/accounts/demo-login` | Login as demo user |

### Wallets (requires JWT)

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `POST` | `/api/v1/wallets` | Create HD wallet |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/wallets` | List user's wallets |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/wallets/{id}` | Wallet details + balance |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/wallets/{id}/address` | Generate next receiving address |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/wallets/{id}/utxos` | List wallet UTXOs |

### Payments (requires JWT + Idempotency-Key)

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `POST` | `/api/v1/payments/charge` | Direct payment (buyer -> merchant) |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/payments/authorize` | Create escrow authorization |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/payments/capture` | Settle authorization |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/payments/void` | Cancel authorization |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/payments/refund` | Refund settled payment |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/payments/{id}` | Payment status |

### Transfers (requires JWT + Idempotency-Key)

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `POST` | `/api/v1/transfers` | Wallet-to-wallet transfer |

### Transactions (requires JWT)

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/api/v1/transactions` | Paginated transaction history |
